name: Soft bokeh
summary: Out-of-focus discs drifting slowly upward in three depth layers, in the theme's accent and text colours.
preview_alt: Soft bokeh over the default dark theme.
changelog: Asks for 15 frames a second instead of 24: the discs drift slowly enough that you can't tell, and it costs about 40 % less GPU time a second. Your own frame rate setting still wins.
